documents.title: Ceramic kiln log
documents.body_md: The ceramic kiln reached a peak temperature of 1215 degrees Celsius during the glaze firing. The cooling vent stayed closed overnight.

documents.title: Bicycle repair record
documents.body_md: The frayed rear brake cable was replaced with a stainless inner cable. Reusing the old housing reduced the bicycle repair parts bill.

documents.title: Seed library ledger
documents.body_md: Nessa handles the return of borrowed seed packets at the seed library. Returned packets go in the blue tin beside the catalogue.

documents.title: Upright piano maintenance card
documents.body_md: The upright piano needs a tuning every six months. Its last inspection found no loose hammers.

documents.title: Telescope packing note
documents.body_md: The telescope eyepieces travel inside the padded red case. The tripod is carried separately.

documents.title: Bread fermentation record
documents.body_md: After mixing, the bread dough rests in the refrigerator for eighteen hours. Shape the loaves before the final proof.
